title: The Artisan of the Hive
party_selection_rule: 5 vs 5 Party Selection (select your 5 designated Pokémon from your active party when prompted at battle start)
overview: Kurt showcases intricate Bug-type synergies blending impenetrable physical armor, hazard-like stat setups, and devious stall tactics. Beedrill/Ariados leads with Quiver Dance and priority Shadow Sneak. Forretress/Cloyster packs astronomical 166 Defense with Iron Defense, but suffers an overwhelming 4x Fire weakness and can detonate with a catastrophic Explosion. Slowbro/Scizor pairs Water/Steel typing with Iron Defense and Recover, stealing stat boosts with Psych Up. Lotad/Kingdra pivots with U-turn while confusing and evading with Double Team. His ace, Blissey/Shuckle, is an astonishing defensive juggernaut with 176 HP, 156 Def, and 166 SpD. It uses Minimize for evasion, Soft-Boiled for 50% recovery, and Power Trick to invert its base Attack and Defense into an offensive behemoth—yet it carries a catastrophic 4x Fighting weakness that must be exploited immediately.

roster.tactics: Quiver Dance lead. Traps with Spider Web while boosting Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed. Pick it off immediately with Flying, Fire, Psychic, or Rock moves before boosts stack.
Colossal 166 physical Defense tank. Sturdy guarantees it survives one hit. Incinerate it with 4x super-effective Fire attacks like Flamethrower. Beware of sudden low-health Explosion.
Bulky Water/Steel anchor. Boosts physical Defense and sustains with Recover. Psych Up copies positive stat boosts from your active Pokémon. Pressure its special side with Electric or Ground.
Evasive hit-and-run pivot. Spams Supersonic confusion and Double Team evasion while firing Dragon Pulse STAB, pivoting out with U-turn. Shut it down with fast Fairy, Dragon, or Sleep status.

Kurt's colossal 582 BST Ace. Combines Blissey's 176 HP with Shuckle's 156 Def and 166 SpD. Leftovers and Soft-Boiled provide immense sustain. Power Trick swaps its 10 Attack with 156 Defense to hit terrifyingly hard with Bug Bite. However, its Normal/Rock typing has a fatal 4x weakness to Fighting: a single STAB Close Combat crushes it into dust.

starter_strategies.bulbasaur: Venusaur/Charizard obliterates Forretress/Cloyster with 4x Flamethrower and disables Lotad/Kingdra with Sleep Powder. Kingler/Primeape is the ultimate boss-slayer, obliterating Blissey/Shuckle with 4x STAB Close Combat. Alakazam/Weezing shreds Beedrill/Ariados with STAB Psychic.
starter_strategies.charmander: Charizard/Venusaur incinerates Beedrill/Ariados and Forretress/Cloyster with Flamethrower, while Sleep Powder prevents Blissey/Shuckle from stacking Minimize. Primeape/Sandslash dismantles Blissey/Shuckle with 4x Close Combat and crumbles Slowbro/Scizor with Earthquake.
starter_strategies.squirtle: Blastoise/Fearow hits Bug types with Flying STAB Drill Peck and washes away rock hybrids. Arbok/Primeape applies Intimidate to blunt Bug Bite and shatters Blissey/Shuckle with 4x Close Combat. Jolteon/Sandslash paralyzes Lotad/Kingdra with Discharge.
